التزمتن (form VIII)
# اِلْتَزَمْتُنَّ (iltazamtunna) /il.ta.zam.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِلْتَزَمَ (iltazama)
# اُلْتُزِمْتُنَّ (ultuzimtunna) /ul.tu.zim.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِلْتَزَمَ (iltazama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
